# html5-qrcode

Vendored version: 2.3.8 (Apache-2.0).
Source: https://unpkg.com/html5-qrcode@2.3.8/html5-qrcode.min.js
Documentation: https://scanapp.org/html5-qrcode-docs/docs/intro

Used by Inventory/js/guidscanner.js for camera-based QR decoding.
The local copy avoids a runtime dependency on a third-party CDN.
